rationale: The SOK 3.2 Help matrix dated September 24 pairs Kubernetes 1.32–1.37 with Enterprise 10.0.12–10.6.0 and advises advancing SOK first. The September 8 project changelog reports Kubernetes 1.32–1.36 and Enterprise 10.6.0. The Queue secretKeyRef breaking change is scoped to Index & Ingestion Separation. General Terms acceptance is separately documented for 3.0.0.

exclusions: No universal Kubernetes maximum, Enterprise 11.x compatibility, app pairing, Cloud availability or authorization is established.
